label: sound
instruction_covers: 206 responses carry Content-Range: bytes start-end/<size> (format given explicitly)
an unsatisfiable start range (bytes=99999- on a 200-byte file) returns 416 Range Not Satisfiable
a suffix range larger than the file (bytes=-99999) clamps to the whole file instead of erroring
FileResponse honors If-Unmodified-Since: date in the past yields 412, a future date still serves the range, an invalid HTTP-date is ignored
FileResponse honors If-Range for conditional ranged GETs: a non-matching validator sends the full 200, a matching one applies the range as 206
notes: The hidden patch only adds assertions to the existing tests/test_web_sendfile_functional.py plus new conditional-request cases; it does not test Accept-Ranges even though the instruction asks for it, so that is extra instruction, not a hidden requirement. The If-Unmodified-Since and If-Range status codes and the invalid-date-ignored rule are the published semantics of the two headers the instruction names and asks to honor, in a task that explicitly requests RFC 7233 compliance (If-Unmodified-Since itself is RFC 7232). The byte counts in the assertions (61108, 13) come from fixture files already in the repo, not from magic constants the engineer must know.
